events.title: The Buckle-Heart Ward
events.description: A huge patched shield props open a heavy rivet gate as the Warden inspects frayed brass seams.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to sew a lasting shield seam (+3 max HP)
Trade 2 max HP of rivets for 24 gold

events.title: The Crimson Quilt Surgeon
events.description: A red needle and trailing thread stitch warm quilt bandages beneath a crimson canopy.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold to dress one hero's wounds (+8 HP)
Donate 4 HP of red thread for a purse of 18 gold

events.title: The Copper-Needle Greenhouse
events.description: Crooked goggles and barbed gears glint among copper-wire ferns and needle-thorn blossoms.

choices.text: Spend 10 gold on soothing gear balm (+6 HP)
Endure 6 HP loss to salvage 3 scraps of barbed gears

events.title: The Thimble-Moon Vigil
events.description: A glowing lantern with a soft moth halo hangs beneath a pale stitched thimble moon.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to strengthen seams in moonlight (+2 max HP)
Lose 4 HP tending the moth candles; earn 20 gold

events.title: The Velvet Straw Mender
events.description: A tattered cape and needle rapier rest on a bed of warm velvet and straw padding.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on velvet straw stuffing (+10 HP)
Give up 5 HP worth of cape padding for 22 gold
Tuck the cape in and depart
